Introduction to Wicomico County Circuit Court

Wicomico County Circuit Court is a vital part of the judicial system in Maryland. Whether you're a resident of Wicomico County or have a case that involves the area, it's important to understand the role of the circuit court and how it operates.

Wicomico County Circuit Court has a rich history dating back to the early days of the state of Maryland. The circuit court system was established in the state in 1637, and Wicomico County Circuit Court has been serving the community since the county was created in 1867. Over the years, the court has undergone numerous changes and renovations, but its commitment to providing justice for all remains steadfast.
